Advocates for regulation of used lead-acid battery recycling to cut the lead pollution it causes. Ambitious Impact published one public model of its work; the most recent, from February 2025, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="labri-aim">40</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.

| Model | By | Date | Years of healthy life per $1,000 | Cells reproduced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [LABRI: advocacy for used lead-acid battery recycling regulation (Ambitious Impact, 2025 idea report)](/labri) | AIM | February 2025 | <span data-figure="headline" data-model="labri-aim">40</span> | 478, 1 kept fixed |

**Purely theoretical.** Ambitious Impact's estimate is of the idea, written before LABRI (Lead-Acid Battery Recycling Initiative) existed, not of the charity's own results. It is shown because LABRI (Lead-Acid Battery Recycling Initiative) runs the programme today ([checked October 2026](https://www.labrecyclinginitiative.com/post/q1-2026-newsletter)) and no model of its actual work exists yet.
